title: Bossbar TimerMod
description: A simple mod that adds an-ingame timer in your bossbar
body:
This mod adds a configurable, in-game timer in your bossbar.
It includes a config file, called 
"timer-config.toml", where you can write up to two custom commands to be executed at the end of the timer. The first one can also include a number variable, that you can setup using a custom scoreboard and a fake player (by default #ServerData, but configurable).

To configure the timer, you can use in-game commands:

/timer set <seconds> ➡️ choose the duration of the timer

/timer start ➡️ start your timer.

/timer add <seconds> ➡️ add (or remove by adding a - before the number) as many seconds as you want to the timer, also if it's alredy running.

/timer stop ➡️ stop the timer.

/timer get ➡️ get the duration of your timer in chat.

**DISCLAIMER:** the mod is developed in Italian, so the writing in the bossbar and the config file will be written in Italian.
